CommunityApplications.Profile:
unraid-plugins is a collection of unRAID plugins. Currently published:
- unraid-unzip: right-click archive extraction for the built-in unRAID File Manager. Extracts 7z, zip, RAR, tar, and the compressed tarballs (.tar.gz, .tgz, .tar.bz2, .tar.xz, .tar.zst) to a destination you choose, with saved passwords, exclude patterns, an overwrite policy, and background jobs.
More plugins may be added to this repository over time; each is listed in plugins/ and documented in the README.
Maintained by h4de5. Report issues in the [GitHub issue tracker](https://github.com/h4de5/unraid-plugins/issues).
